notes.title: Questing 4 Autism
notes.content:
We’re so excited to invite you to our gaming event to raise money for the Autism Society of Texas.  We’ve got a number of great indie games to play while you hang out with developers from the industry, watch some entertaining influencers and support a worthwhile cause.  

Join us Live on Twitch or in Person at the venue.  Your registration includes a chance at great giveaways from Alienware, Trader Joe's and RedTigerPro. Check out the website for more info:
https://runsignup.com/Race/TX/Austin/QuestingForAutism

notes.title: DeepL Localization Added for NL, ES and DE
notes.content:
It has been some time since our last update.  Almost a whole year, but we have come back to add some localization to Yoko Redux.  You will now be able to view the dialog subtitles, cutscenes and menus in three new languages.  

We've included localization by DeepL machine learning in Dutch, Spanish and German.  While we know that the AI may not be able to replicate a real translator, it fit the game too perfectly to go any other direction.  We hope many more people can enjoy Yoko Redux in their native language now.

notes.title: Narspel Jacks Update
notes.content:
Just in time for Christmas and the Steam Winter sale comes the Narspel Jacks update for Yoko Redux!

Enjoy a fun and relaxing game of cards with the various inhabitants of Novo Redentor while you discover the world and the answer to the question, Who is Yoko? 

You will be able to collect all the cards available, mix and match them and create your own decks to challenge anyone you come across.  

Control different characters and hardware from the game with the goal of wiping out all of your opponent's characters to win.  Focus on the Mind, a resource mainly used to buff characters; the Body which is focused on damaging characters; the Soul which is focused on control or any combination thereof. 

Earn more cards by defeating the people you come across in game and build your ultimate deck.   

We even have plans for physical (real world) card packs to play Narspel Jacks with your friends.

notes.title: Episode 4 Launch!
notes.content:
Our first major update for Yoko Redux: Dreams of a Blue Planet is DONE!  Level 4 is complete and ready to be tackled by new and veteran players alike.  

Continue the story and see what Jeanne is up to on her mission to Kill Yoko!  If you need a recap, hop back in at level 1 and see if you can beat my time of 18 min. to speed run level 1 and 2.  

You can read the patch notes below, but I specifically want to point out that there have been a few QOL updates for level 3 that tie into our plans for achievements later on.  

Stay up to date with us and be ready for levels 5-7 in the coming months.

notes.title: Return of the Crack the Codes Event!
notes.content:
Fancy yourself a Decker?  A Rebel?  A Resistance Fighter? Can you work out hacks quicker than Anne can stop them?  Then head over to the main [url=Yokoredux.com]Yoko Redux Website[/url] and try your hand at cracking the codes.  Successful Deckers can win a key to Yoko Redux, Roguecraft Squadron and a special discord title to let everyone know, you're the one to look out for!  

This event will continue until the launch of our first major update to the game on Oct. 28, which will introduce Level 4 (of 7 total)!  Remember, all new levels are included in the original purchase price of the game, so buy it once and get all newly released levels for free!

If you have already played the first 3 levels, and are excited to continue the story, mark this event to be notified when Level 4 drops.  If you have not yet played the game, be sure to try and crack the codes for a chance to win a free copy!

notes.title: Yoko Redux and the Magic Number
notes.content:
We've hit that magic number of reviews and would like to send out a heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who has tried out the Demo, purchased the game and/or left a review.  We really appreciate all of your support and are encouraged to keep working on this great adventure game for our great fans.  

If you've finished the first three levels, don't forget to check the roadmap in the description on the main store page.  The story continues with Level 4 and it is scheduled to be launched in October.  As always, all of the remaining 4 levels (up to level 7) will be included in the base game at no extra cost as they are updated, so be ready to continue the adventure with Jeanne on her mission and all of our main characters as they discover "Who is Yoko?"

While you're waiting, don't forget to grab the OST and continue that Yoko feeling.  

We have much more to come and hope you'll be along for the journey.  

THANK YOU! THANK YOU! THANK YOU!
